error[ZBX-E0230]: no CDI spec has that device
  cause  no spec in /etc/cdi, /var/run/cdi and $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/cdi has it
  fix    write the host's CDI spec first:   nvidia-ctk cdi generate --format=json --output=/etc/cdi/nvidia.json
  more   zbx explain E0230 · rerun with --verbose for the full cause chain
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigbox/errors/E0230.html
